_about: ENCORE token registry. Every listed token is keyed by its Solana mint address. 'listed: true' tokens appear in the ENCORE market; everything else is shown in the archive with the reason it is not tradable here. launchPlatform is only set where it is well documented; null renders as 'Unverified'. Market data, token age and pools always come from live providers, never from this file.

tokens.name: Samoyedcoin
tokens.blurb: One of the first Solana dog coins, billed as the chain's ambassador long before memecoins were a Solana staple.

tokens.name: dogwifhat
tokens.blurb: A dog in a knitted hat. Became the face of the 2024 Solana meme run, complete with a crowdfunded Las Vegas Sphere campaign.

tokens.name: Myro
tokens.blurb: Named after the dog of Solana co-founder Raj Gokal. One of the loudest coins of the late-2023 cycle before fading from view.

tokens.name: POPCAT
tokens.blurb: The open-mouth cat meme as a coin. Led the cat rotation that challenged dog-coin dominance on Solana.

tokens.name: BOOK OF MEME
tokens.blurb: An 'archive of meme culture' coin that reached major exchange listings within days and kicked off the March 2024 presale frenzy.

tokens.name: cat in a dogs world
tokens.blurb: A cat holding out in a dog-coin world. Launched with most of its liquidity burned and grew into one of Solana's largest cat coins.

tokens.name: michi
tokens.blurb: A lopsided cat drawn in MS Paint style. A community favorite of the spring 2024 cat wave.

tokens.name: GIGACHAD
tokens.blurb: The Gigachad meme turned into a slow-grind community coin, known for holders who refused to sell.

tokens.name: FWOG
tokens.blurb: A tiny frog from pump.fun's breakout summer. One of the bonding-curve launches that graduated and kept a following.

tokens.name: Moo Deng
tokens.blurb: Named after the viral baby pygmy hippo from a Thai zoo. Rode the news cycle from cute clip to top-traded token in weeks.

tokens.name: Goatseus Maximus
tokens.blurb: Launched on pump.fun and championed by the Truth Terminal AI account. Opened the AI-agent meme season.

tokens.name: Fartcoin
tokens.blurb: A pump.fun joke coin linked to the Truth Terminal era that went much further than anyone expected.

tokens.name: Peanut the Squirrel
tokens.blurb: Created on pump.fun after Peanut, a pet squirrel, made national headlines. A textbook news-driven meme.

tokens.name: Just a chill guy
tokens.blurb: The 'chill guy' dog drawing that took over social feeds in late 2024, minted on pump.fun at the peak of the trend.

tokens.name: PONKE
tokens.blurb: A chaotic monkey from the late-2023 run that built one of Solana's loudest meme communities.

tokens.name: Wen
tokens.blurb: Named after crypto's favorite question. A community airdrop built around a cat poem, launched at the start of the 2024 airdrop wave.

tokens.name: Silly Dragon
tokens.blurb: A goofy dragon from the December 2023 rush, one of the early names in that season's meme wave.

tokens.name: Mumu the Bull
tokens.blurb: A cartoon bull built as the market's mascot. Grew fast in spring 2024, then went quiet.

tokens.name: Shark Cat
tokens.blurb: A cat wearing a shark costume. One of the cat-rotation coins of spring 2024.

tokens.name: MOTHER IGGY
tokens.blurb: The celebrity coin of the May 2024 wave, tied to a well-known musician.

tokens.name: zerebro
tokens.blurb: An autonomous AI-artist token from the late-2024 AI-agent season.

tokens.name: USELESS COIN
tokens.blurb: Proudly does nothing. A 2025 launchpad meme that leaned into having no utility at all.

tokens.name: SLERF (pre-migration mint)
tokens.blurb: Famous for a launch-day mistake that burned its own presale and LP tokens.
tokens.notListedReason: SLERF migrated to a new token in September 2025. This is the old mint. ENCORE has not yet verified the new mint, so it is not listed for voting or trading.

otherChains.name: Dogecoin
otherChains.blurb: The original memecoin (2013). Runs on its own blockchain.

otherChains.name: Pepe
otherChains.blurb: ERC-20 frog coin from the 2023 Ethereum meme wave.
